leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the display: flex property to create a flex container.
Configure the flex-direction property to arrange items in a row.
Manipulate the flex-direction property to arrange items in a column.
Construct a layout that uses flex-direction: row-reverse.
Initialize a layout that uses flex-direction: column-reverse.
Integrate multiple flex-direction values within a single container to compare visual outcomes.
Control the visual order of flex items by adjusting the flex-direction property.
